svg.text: A microkernel with typed extension slots. The kernel owns the run loop, the policy gate and the event log. Every provider, tool, workflow, role, runner and channel is a plugin.
Builds on what exists today: core/manifest.py, core/registry.py, core/ports.py, core/bus.py and the plugins table (migration 0006).
Event bus: typed topics · batched outbox · replay by seq · observers subscribe here
Anything a person uses. The web app builds its routes and panels from UI plugins.
Channel slot. Adapters turn a transport into application calls and hold no business logic.
same use cases as the API
One use case per user action. The only code a channel may call. Replaces services/ and router logic.
start run · send message · resolve approval · read projections
Small and stable. Knows no provider, tool or workflow by name; it runs whatever the slots hold.
One actor per run, with its own mailbox
and pause, step and stop controls.
Checkpoints every turn, resumes after a crash.
the same path for every action; no tool can skip step 4
calls slot protocols; the host wraps each call with a timeout, retries and metrics
Each slot is an SDK protocol. Plugins fill slots and never import one another.
only slot plugins reach the outside world
Outside the code. Reached through a storage plugin or a slot plugin, never directly.
The only package a plugin imports. Versioned; each manifest declares the SDK range it supports.
Dependency rule, checked by import-linter: clients → channels → application → kernel → SDK. Plugins import only the SDK; they never import the kernel or each other.
eager, or lazy on first use
Toggle in Settings → Plugins. Octopus lists the dependents
first and drains them before the plugin stops.
How the design meets the goals
• Outbox commits in batches, not once per event
• Stable prompt prefix gets cached-input pricing
• Read-only tool calls in a turn run in parallel
• Run state rebuilds from the event log
• Idempotency keys stop repeated writes on retry
• Timeout, retry, circuit breaker on each slot call
• A failing plugin degrades; the run continues
• Bounded queues; slow sockets replay from seq
• Disabled plugins load no code, start no process
• Plugins meet only through the SDK and the bus
• Swap a provider or runner with one setting
Plugin: can be enabled, disabled or replaced
Event bus: any layer publishes or subscribes
